thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach for customer 'Orion Quantum' (VPC: euc1, dedicated pool dq-orion-euc1). p99 = 12.9s (SLO 2.5s). Traffic surge detected from tenant 'quantum-sim' — elevated tail latency across routers.
alice (eng-oncall): Acknowledged. Paging Alice.
dmitri (sre): I'm on call — collecting traces, can someone post pool metrics?
carla (infra): Posting quick snapshot: dedicated pool dq-orion-euc1 GPU util 95%, queue depth spiking, KV cache miss rate +48%.
alice (eng-oncall): Thanks. Is this tenant noisy or global shift?
kira (account-exec): Orion's traffic spike started at 09:12 UTC after a large model roll. They reported errors to their ops team.
bob (platform): Confirmed model roll. New variant 'gptx-3.4-q' rolled to 100% in that pool at 09:10.
dmitri (sre): Risk: new variant has longer per-token latency and larger KV size -> reduced throughput.
alice (eng-oncall): Immediate mitigation: can we rollback model or route Orion to warm fallback model?
carla (infra): We can do a rapid rollback to 'gptx-3.3-q' (known perf). Preparing rollback patch.
deploy-bot: Deployment: rollback job started for dq-orion-euc1 -> target model gptx-3.3-q. Job id: dep-87231
alice (eng-oncall): Also proposing tenant isolation: spin up an isolated pool for 'quantum-sim' to protect other customers.
bob (platform): Spinning isolated pool requires eviction of non-Orion tenants or new warm pool spinup. Warm pool (~3 nodes) estimated 6 mins.
dmitri (sre): Short-term: enable downstream throttling/queue limits for tenant 'quantum-sim' to shed some load.
alice (eng-oncall): Applying throttling now: rate limit 0.5 RPS per key for that tenant. Command:
```
rbctl tenant throttle --tenant quantum-sim --rps 0.5 --reason "emergency evict"
```
dmitri (sre): Throttle applied. Observing dropped requests but overall p95 improved to 1.8s, p99 down from 12.9s -> 4.7s. Still above SLO.
carla (infra): Rollback status: dep-87231 completed, model back to gptx-3.3-q across pool. Rebalancing caches.
alice (eng-oncall): Good. Start warm pool for Orion, move their traffic gradually.
bob (platform): Warm pool ready: dq-orion-euc1-warm (3 nodes). Starting gradual reroute (10% increments).
pagerduty: On-call handoff requested: dmitri -> alice at 10:05 UTC for continued monitoring.
kira (account-exec): Notifying Orion: "We've rolled back the model and are moving you to an isolated warm pool; you may see intermittent throttling for 10-15 minutes."
dmitri (sre): p99 now 1.9s after 40% reroute. p95 steady at ~1.5s. Queue depths normalizing.
alice (eng-oncall): Closing war room soon. Postmortem: root cause = premature 100% rollout of higher-latency model to dedicated pool without staged perf test. Action items: enforce canary, perf gate, and auto-evict policy for dedicated pools.
kira (account-exec): I'll schedule customer post-incident call with Orion for 14:00 UTC.
alice (eng-oncall): Thanks. Leaving monitoring on. Marking incident as mitigated — will follow up with full incident writeup.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated: p99 back under SLO (1.9s). Incident id: INC-2026-01738. Notify: #incidents, #eng-oncall.
